slug.description: URL-friendly slug, the language-independent identity of the tag

translations.description: Names of the tag, one per language. `cs` is required (400 without a non-empty one), `en` is optional and the web falls back to `cs` without it

name.description: Name of the tag in this language. An empty name is skipped (for `en` it means no English name, the web shows the Czech one); `cs` needs a non-empty name
